description: Keep pathname strings whose lexical final filename extension equals the supplied case-sensitive text.

interface.semantic_input: Ordered POSIX pathname text and an exact extension selector, including its dot when present.
interface.semantic_output: An ordered subsequence of the original pathname strings.

dependencies: C++17 standard library and filesystem support
resources: Inspects every input path and copies matching strings into the result. Memory limits and scaling remain unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: Provide an in-memory vector and a text selector. An empty selector is allowed and matches a path with an empty lexical extension.

postconditions.detail: Returned the original matching strings, preserving their order, bytes and multiplicity in the tested cases.

refinements.detail: The comparison is case-sensitive. A lone leading dot does not start an extension. A trailing dot counts as extension dot. The selector tests only the final extension, including the delimiter.

effects.detail: The client input vector remained unchanged. File I/O in the ordinary checks belongs to the surrounding reader and writer.

invariants.detail: A directory component containing a dot did not change the final filename extension. Repeated matching inputs produced repeated outputs.

mathematical_properties.detail: No general property proof or generated exhaustive domain was attempted.

formal_predicates.detail: No verified formal model of filesystem lexical extension was used.

state_protocol.detail: The interface is a single synchronous call with no retained state object.

ownership.detail: Borrows both arguments by const reference and returns owned strings in a vector by value.

upstream_usage.detail: The pinned project example selects the exact .log filename extension from three pathname records.

specification_question.detail: Which final extension should match, and should letter case matter? This filter compares case-sensitively.
